title: Validated-model Lambda/IMC PI tuning
equipment: Electric recirculating water heater, outlet-temperature sensor, heater power stage, and cold-flow load
physicalPurpose: Produce and qualify a reproducible PI tuning for outlet temperature without silently applying gains.
principalTechnique: Lambda/IMC PI calculation and common-plan tuning qualification
objective: Choose a closed-loop response target, calculate PI gains from the validated FOPDT model, and compare them with empirical tuning under nominal and uncertain conditions.

simplifications: One well-mixed local thermal state with fixed-flow command-model eligibility.
The cold-flow event is a regulatory test outside the identified command model's predicted input path.
The uncertainty case perturbs gain, time constant, delay, and measurement noise deterministically.
Spatial, nonlinear, efficiency, and hardware-protection behavior are omitted.

baseline.limitation: The empirical tuning works but does not expose a reproducible model assumption or explicit robustness-speed target.

change.decision: Calculate an unapplied candidate from frozen K/T/L and Lambda, then compare it against the empirical tuning with one common nominal and perturbed plan.

disturbances: Start at 30.2 degC and 20 percent heater power, then request 30.6 degC
Cold-flow load lowers output bias from 30.2 to 29.8 degC at 60 s
Perturbed case uses K=0.19, T=6, L=1.3 and 0.03 degC deterministic measurement noise

abortPredicates: SP, PV, MV, model parameter, Lambda, or calculated gain is nonfinite
model or tuning input is outside its declared engineering bounds
requirements are infeasible inside actuator or model-validity limits
PV or MV leaves its hard limit
approved qualification PV or MV leaves the accepted local model range
candidate, plant, event, seed, timing, or axes differ without declaration
simulationOnlyRestrictions: Simulation qualification does not prove physical performance or extend the fixed-flow model purpose.
Generate and validate candidates without applying; physical action requires topology review and immediate approval.

video.viewerOutcome: Calculate a Lambda PI from a validated model and qualify its speed, robustness, and actuator trade-offs against the existing empirical tuning.

learning.context: The heater has an empirical PI baseline and a validated fixed-flow FOPDT command model with explicit uncertainty and purpose restriction.
learning.reason: Model-based tuning makes the response target and calculation reproducible, but still requires common-plan qualification against uncertainty, noise, disturbances, and limits.
theory: Lambda is a desired closed-loop response time: smaller values usually increase speed and gains while reducing robustness to delay, noise, and model error.
For this FOPDT PI rule, Kp=T/[K(lambda+L)], Ti=min[T,4(lambda+L)], and Ki=Kp/Ti with explicit engineering units.
Only independently validated model purposes and ranges are eligible, and parameter intervals define representative perturbation cases.
A candidate is a recommendation until explicit Apply approval; calculation never establishes performance by itself.
learning.workedPrediction: K=0.2 degC/%, T=5 s, L=1 s, and lambda=4 s give Kp=5 %/degC, Ti=5 s, and Ki=1 %/(degC*s), compared with empirical Kp=4 and Ki=0.8.
practicalPreparation: Inspect model identity, provenance, restriction, parameter intervals, signals, units, operating point, timing, limits, safe state, and unapplied status.
Declare nominal and perturbed requirements, calculate the candidate by hand, and freeze equal experiments before running.
learning.baseline: Run empirical Kp=4 and Ki=0.8 on the nominal setpoint and cold-flow plan and retain complete evidence.
learning.change: Use one reviewed ExperimentEnabled authority to make the project generate, validate, apply, run, and then roll back Kp=5 and Ki=1 from the frozen model and lambda=4 s.
learning.comparison: Compare equal-axis time responses, tracking and load IAE, final error, saturation, and MV travel; then repeat the selected candidate with declared K/T/L/noise perturbations.
learning.validation: Require at least 2 percent IAE improvement, perturbed final error at most 0.2 degC, finite signals, bounded MV, visible activity, and deterministic rejection of invalid or infeasible inputs.
learning.explanation: The explicit target explains the faster response and higher actuator activity; passing remains local Simulation evidence rather than universal or physical proof.
learning.transfer: For another eligible process, validate first, choose a response target from requirements and uncertainty, calculate with units, compare on one plan, perturb the model, retain all trade-offs, and require explicit Apply approval.
